questions.q: Where does Leviticus say the life of the flesh is?
questions.evidence: For the life of the flesh is in the blood

questions.q: Whom did Moses anoint by pouring oil on his head?
questions.evidence: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him

questions.q: What came out from Yahweh and devoured Nadab and Abihu?
questions.evidence: Fire came out from before Yahweh, and devoured them, and they died before Yahweh

questions.q: Besides parting the hoof, what must an animal do for Israel to eat it?
questions.evidence: Whatever parts the hoof, and is cloven-footed, and chews the cud among the animals, that you may eat

questions.q: On the Day of Atonement, Aaron cast lots over two of what?
questions.evidence: Aaron shall cast lots for the two goats

questions.q: Where was the goat carrying the people's iniquities sent?
questions.evidence: and he shall put them on the head of the goat, and shall send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness

questions.q: Leviticus says you shall love your neighbor as whom?
questions.evidence: but you shall love your neighbor as yourself

questions.q: Why does Yahweh tell Israel to be holy?
What was the fiftieth year to be?
questions.evidence: It shall be a jubilee to you

questions.q: If Israel walks in his statutes, what does God promise they will be?
questions.evidence: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people
